meta.name: email-marketing
meta.description: 产品发布邮件, 含 masthead、hero、CTA、规格表, table-fallback

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成产品发布邮件，包含头部、主图、行动号召和规格表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为新产品发布制作专业营销邮件
copy.tagline_en: Generate product launch emails with masthead, hero, CTA, and spec table
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create professional marketing emails for a new product launch

howto.what: 生成纯 HTML 的产品发布邮件,600px 单栏,含 Masthead、Hero 图块、标题、正文、CTA 按钮、三列规格表、页脚(社交+退订);用表格兜底布局,颜色直接写在标签内,兼容邮件客户端。
howto.when: 当你提出要做产品发布邮件或营销邮件,并提供产品信息、文案或素材时触发。

say.text: 我要给新品写封邮件,包含大图、标题、正文和购买按钮。
say.note: 会输出一版带 CTA 的发布邮件。

say.text: 帮我做一封兼容 Outlook 的营销邮件,用这个产品规格表。
say.note: 会采用表格布局并在邮件客户端兼容。

say.text: 写封产品发布邮件,加上社交链接和退订。
say.note: 会生成含页脚的完整邮件。

howto.what_en: Generates a pure-HTML product launch email, 600px single-column, with masthead, hero, headline, body copy, CTA, 3-column spec grid, footer; uses tables for fallback and inline styles for colors to suit email clients.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a product launch or marketing email and provide product info, copy, or assets.

say_en.text: Write an email for my new product with hero, headline, body and a buy button.
say_en.note: Outputs a launch email with CTA.

say_en.text: Make an Outlook-compatible marketing email with this spec table.
say_en.note: Uses table layout for client compatibility.

say_en.text: Draft a product launch email with social links and unsubscribe.
say_en.note: Generates a full email with footer.
